replies.author: DonaldMyTrump
replies.body:
Looks rather CTH-ish. Maybe add an additional ring or make some raised areas to make it more nexus-ish. Is the outer ring on the same level as the main/center? If not is it higher or lower?

On the upside bow pvp looks like it would be fun there and the aesthetics are nice. :) Please build more together. I would really like to see what you two can do.
